findings.physical_locator: Fourth main text row; left-middle. Inspect overlapping native boxes [1230,620,2100,850] and [2000,620,2720,850].
findings.disposition: Retain existing supplied text with unresolved scan marker; no emendation proposed.
findings.bounded_reading: The left sequence is compatible with སོ་སོའི་བྱེད་; the distinct right segment is compatible with པའི་རྒྱུ་འགགས་པ།. The intervening fused cluster and its relation to the tall vertical stroke remain unresolved. These partial observations are not a reconstructed continuous transcription.
findings.reason: The wider native context shows a separate right-hand segment beyond the cluster. The reviewer cannot reliably allocate the dense middle strokes or decide whether the apparent boundary belongs to punctuation, glyphs, or an intervention. Assigning the expected pa'i rgyu to the cluster alone would not account for the wider visual context.
findings.review_action: Have a qualified reader inspect both overlapping crops against the original scan; determine all letters and physical boundaries before changing the unit or declaring lexical completion.
